title: (3) Discord | "Suggestion: Add More AI Model Options, such as DeepSeek / GLM" | 프론티아

msgs.txt:
2026-08-10 · moved from old-suggestions-global
Currently, the number of AI models available in the app feels a bit limited. It would be great if more model options could be added in the future, such as DeepSeek or the GLM series.

Different AI models have their own strengths when it comes to novel writing, character development, long-context understanding, writing style, and Chinese-language generation. Giving users more models to choose from based on their needs would make the app much more flexible.

DeepSeek and GLM, in particular, perform quite well with Chinese content, so I think they would be great additions to the current model selection.

Hope the development team can consider it. Thanks!

Hello, this is Sion from the Frontia team:)

Thank you so much for taking the time to write out such a thoughtful and
detailed suggestion.

It's exactly as you say — each model has its own strengths when it comes to
storytelling, character portrayal, long-context understanding, and writing
style, and the language being written in makes a difference too. And on that
note, we have some good news to share: DeepSeek and the GLM series are in fact
being tested right now with a view to bringing them to Frontia. We can't promise
a date just yet, but it's actively in progress, so please do look forward to it.

Suggestions like yours are a genuine help in making Frontia better, and we're
truly grateful you shared it with us. We'll keep listening closely to the voices
of our users and keep building Frontia together with you.

Thank you.
Sion, Frontia team
TYSM. Looking forward to hearing some good news soon!
